verdict.rationale: The CLI supports installing all skills via `'*'`, multiple skills via repeated `--skill` flags, multiple target agents via repeated `-a` flags, org/user-wide search (`skills find --owner`), bulk update (`skills update` with no args), and bulk remove/list operations — all documented with concrete command examples across many items at once. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of true bulk operations at scale, and one community comment (skills-cli-comm-7) claims package-management basics like updates/uninstalls aren't documented, which is contradicted by other CLI docs but adds some uncertainty.
